intro: If you're driving into Surin and want a newer, clean, quiet room for a few hundred baht, with easy parking and a mall on your doorstep, S-House Hotel Surin is a name that comes up often in reviews · It's a budget hotel in Salak Dai, on the edge of Surin, in a newer building with clean rooms and soft beds, set a short walk across the car park from Robinson Lifestyle Surin — from around ฿490/night · Real guest reviews praise the cleanliness, the fresh rooms, the wide free parking and the quiet setting (many even mention the resident cat that comes to say hello) · The main gripes are that it's not central — you'll want a car to get around — and that rooms have no kettle or tea/coffee set.

body.html: S-House Hotel Surin is a budget hotel in Salak Dai, at 380 Moo 16, on the edge of Surin near Robinson · The building is still new, with around 30 rooms, and it positions itself clearly as a few-hundred-baht stay that's newer and cleaner than its price suggests · What sets it apart from an older guesthouse is that the rooms genuinely look new — the walls and floors are still crisp, the beds are soft and the air-con is cold — and there's wide free parking out front, ideal for anyone driving in who wants somewhere easy to leave the car.

Rooms range from a Standard with a large bed up to a Standard Twin, and some have a small balcony or terrace · What guests mention consistently is that the rooms are very clean, the beds and pillows are soft, the air-con cools fast and the shower pressure is good · Every room has air-con, a TV and a separate bathroom, and some have a fridge · The trade-off is that this is a budget hotel — in-room amenities are basic, many rooms have no kettle or tea/coffee set, and small touches like tissues or hangers are sometimes in short supply.
"Lovely new, very clean room, soft bed, cold air-con, nice and quiet, easy parking, and you can walk straight across to Robinson — there's even a cute cat to greet you. Excellent for the price."

The overall feel is calm and quiet, as it sits in the Salak Dai area rather than the busy downtown · Many reviews like the peaceful setting and the little garden out front, along with the resident cat that's become a small charm of the place · Breakfast and lunch are served, the front desk is open 24 hours, there's an EV charger, plus luggage storage and laundry · One thing reviews note is that weekends get busier thanks to the mall next door, and the front desk can be lightly staffed at peak times, so you may wait a little.

On location, let's be clear: S-House stands out for sitting right next to Robinson Lifestyle Surin — you walk across the car park straight to the mall, with restaurants, a supermarket and a cinema inside · But the hotel is on the edge of town, not the centre — it's about 6 km from Surin Train Station and the old market area, roughly a 10-minute drive or ride · If you arrive by train without onward transport, getting around won't be as easy as from a downtown hotel · But if you drive in or rent a car, this spot is actually convenient: easy parking and quick access to the ring road out to the Khmer ruins around the province.

To be honest, per real guest sentiment: S-House is a budget hotel that scores notably well on cleanliness and value, but it isn't a luxury stay and isn't central · The people who love it tend to be driving in, after a fresh, clean, quiet room with easy parking and the convenience of a mall next door · Those who are disappointed usually expected a central, walk-everywhere location, or full in-room amenities like a bigger hotel · Understand that before you book and you'll get a stay that fits a car-based trip to Surin nicely.

In short, if you're coming to Surin by car and want a newer, clean, quiet room with easy free parking and a mall on your doorstep, starting at just a few hundred baht — S-House is a sensible pick · Its overall score of around 8.8 from real reviews, with cleanliness up in the low 9s, captures the picture accurately: "new, clean, quiet, good value, next to the mall" · It suits road-tripping families, budget-minded couples and business travellers who'd rather stay just outside the bustle of the centre.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a room in the newer building and one set back from the road for the best condition and the most quiet · If you want tea or coffee in the room, bring your own or grab some from the Robinson next door · Checking in on a weekend evening can mean a short wait, as it gets busy · And if you're visiting during the Surin Elephant Round-up (mid-November), book several weeks ahead, as the whole city fills up fast.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — S-House Hotel Surin

faq.q: Where is S-House Hotel Surin, and can I walk from the train station?
faq.a: S-House Hotel Surin is at 380 Moo 16, Salak Dai, Mueang Surin, right next to Robinson Lifestyle Surin — you walk across the car park to the mall · But it's on the edge of town, about 6 km from Surin Train Station (a 10–12 minute drive), too far to walk · It suits drivers more than anyone arriving by train without onward transport.

faq.q: How much does S-House Hotel Surin cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿490/night for a Standard Double · A Standard Twin runs about ฿540, a Superior around ฿620 and a Family Room for three around ฿850 · Prices vary by date and platform, and rise during the Surin Elephant Round-up — compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Are the rooms at S-House Hotel Surin clean and new?
faq.a: Most reviews praise the cleanliness and the rooms that look new as the biggest plus here · The beds and pillows are soft, the air-con cools fast, the shower pressure is good and the rooms are quiet · Cleanliness scores from real reviews reach into the low 9s · One caveat: many rooms have no kettle or tea/coffee set, and small items are sometimes in short supply.

faq.q: Who is S-House Hotel Surin best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for drivers, families road-tripping in Surin and budget travellers who'd rather stay just outside the busy centre · There's wide free parking, a quiet setting and you can walk to Robinson · It's not for those arriving by train without a car, or anyone wanting a central, walk-everywhere location.

faq.q: Does S-House Hotel Surin have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes — the hotel serves breakfast and has wide free parking out front, plus an EV charger · The front desk is open 24 hours, with luggage storage and laundry · And since it's next to Robinson, you can easily find more restaurants and a supermarket just across the car park.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, especially for the Surin Elephant Round-up?
faq.a: In normal periods, 1–2 weeks ahead is fine · But for the Surin Elephant Round-up in mid-November, book several weeks ahead, as the whole city fills fast · Every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm yet.
